description: This file contains extension methods for the Orleans ISiloBuilder interface to configure fault injection and transactional state storage in a clustered environment, specifically for controlled fault injection testing scenarios.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring fault injection and transactional storage during silo building.

methods.name: UseControlledFaultInjectionTransactionState
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use a controlled fault injection transactional state mechanism during cluster startup.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Adds fault injection Azure Table transactional state storage to the Orleans silo builder with default provider name.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage (overload)
methods.description: Adds fault injection Azure Table transactional state storage to the Orleans silo builder with a specified provider name and configuration options.
